title: Ogbe okwute gị, ire ere nke ọma na atụmatụ ụbọchị iri itoolu

say: Ogbe okwute gị, ire ere nke ọma, yana atụmatụ ụbọchị 90.
Nke a bụ vidiyo maka Modul 4 nke Nhazi Nri Obere.
Nkume isi gị bụ otu ezigbo ogbe, nke ejiri ihe niile ị mụtara mee. 2 ruo 5 n'arọ nke ngwaahịa emechara ezuru.
Nke mbụ, dozie uzommeputa gị na ọnụọgụgụ, dịka ọmụmaatụ 3 kg nke raw groundnuts, 1% nnu, na 250 g ite.

say: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, Zainab dị na Bauchi na-azụta ahịhịa dị kilogram 3.0 wee kpụpụta kilogram 0.15 nke mkpọkọrọ, gbajiri agbaji na nke agbajiri agbaji. Nke ahụ bụ ebe ọ na-achịkwa nke ọma megide aflatoxin, o wee see foto.

panel.heading: rere ya, ma ọ bụ tụfuo ya?
left: Na-esi ísì ụtọ ma na-atọ ụtọ
right: Akpụkpọ anụ, mọstad ma ọ bụ ísì ọjọọ

say: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-ahụ ebu, na-esi isi ihe ọ bụla musty ma ọ bụ rancid, chọta ihe mba ọzọ, ma ọ bụ CCP dara na enweghị ike mezie ya, erela ya ma ọ bụ nye ya.
Dekọọ ya dị ka ogbe dara ada, mara ihe kpatara ya, ma tụfuo ya. Ogbe dara ada nwere nkuzi doro anya ka bụ ezigbo ihe akaebe.

say: Jiri ụfọdụ eziokwu, eziokwu sitere na usoro nke gị. E ghere eghe na mmanụ ọhụrụ n'oge a na-enyocha ya, jụrụ ya nke ọma ma mechie ya na obere akpa foil ka ọ nọgide na-agbaji.

say: N'ime ụbọchị 1 ruo 30, mee obere batches abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ ọzọ, na-agbanwe otu ihe n'otu oge. Debe ndekọ zuru ezu.

panel.heading: Atụmatụ ụbọchị 90
items: Ụbọchị 1 ruo 30: megharịa ma nụchaa
Ụbọchị 31 ruo 60: nwalee ma ree
Ụbọchị 61 ruo 90: kpebie ma hazie ya

say: N'ime ụbọchị 31 ruo 60, resị ya obere, otu kwụ ọtọ wee soro ndị na-azụ ahịa na-emeghachi, mkpesa na mkpụrụ.
Dịka ọmụmaatụ, Funmi na-ezube ire obere akpa 50 g nye ndị na-azụ ahịa oge niile 15, yana ebumnuche nke opekata mpe 8 ndị na-azụ ahịa ọzọ.

say: N'ime ụbọchị 61 ruo 90, nyochaa nọmba gị wee kpebie: gaa n'ihu, gbanwee, ma ọ bụ kwaga na ndebanye aha CAC na NAFDAC.
Ngwaahịa gị dị njikere maka ọrịre sara mbara mgbe batches atọ n'usoro ruru oke gị, dobe ihe nlele gị, yana ọnụ ahịa gị na-ekpuchi ọnụ ahịa zuru oke.

panel.rule: Njikere ire ere: batches atọ dị mma, ndụ nchekwa nwalere, ọnụ ahịa ọrụ.

say: Icheta. Hazie batch gị wee dekọọ nlele ọ bụla ka ị na-ewere ya. Ya adịla mgbe erere ogbe nwere ebu, rancidity ma ọ bụ CCP dara ada. Na-ere na ezi eziokwu. Jiri nọmba batch chọpụta mkpesa. Nyekwa atụmatụ ụbọchị 90 gị ezigbo ọnụọgụgụ.

panel.heading: Cheta

say: Ugbu a were foto ogbo na ọnụ ahịa ụtọ were were were batch gị mee nnukwu ihe. Kwadebe ngwa ahịa gị na usoro mkpesa gị. Wee chikọta mkpọ ihe akaebe gị wee dee atụmatụ ụbọchị iri itoolu gị.
Ma ị na-eme kilogram 2 ma ọ bụ 200, otu iwu ịdị ọcha na ịkwụwa aka ọtọ na-emetụta. Gaa n'ihu na nkuzi ndị dị n'okpuru.
